text_simplified: Parents must teach their children to slaughter the sacrificial ram on Eid al-Adha, taking into account the child’s age and ability to perform the slaughter. It is preferable to train the child gradually in slaughtering, starting from the age of seven, and to reinforce their behavior with appropriate rewards.
